name: uiux
description: UI/UX from user journey to verified screen: journey specs (job stories, breadboards, Gherkin acceptance), tool-agnostic design system architecture (DTCG tokens, components, accessibility), design in Penpot or Figma via MCP, screenshot-to-design-system, Pencil .pen files, and design-vs-implementation parity checks.
